purpose: A21 runtime pilot; not formal performance inference
stage_policy: Fully drain A1 HPO before A2 Search/Audit; frozen seeded order inside stages
proxy_policy: All inherited proxy variables removed; NO_PROXY=no_proxy=*
credential_policy: Private key file used only in memory for health and the authorized client; no secret value in argv or receipts
semantic_failure_policy: Retain zeros, early answers, empty answers, protocol errors, and length stops; no outcome-directed resampling
infrastructure_failure_policy: Frozen bounded retries only; stop new dispatch and drain started work on integrity or infrastructure failure
